====================================================================================================
Casts between numbers, NULL and booleans

Each case runs as CAST. TRY_CAST follows a case only when CAST fails at runtime, to show which rows
become NULL. Where CAST succeeds, TRY_CAST is checked to return the same values and is not listed;
where CAST fails type checking, TRY_CAST is checked to fail it too.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Numbers and NULL

A number converts to another number type when its value fits, and fails otherwise; a float drops its
fraction under the default function context. NULL converts to NULL of a nullable type, and CAST to a
type that is not nullable fails on it. Arrays and tuples convert element by element.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST(0 AS UINT8)
raw expr       : CAST(0 AS UInt8)
checked expr   : 0_u8
output type    : UInt8
output domain  : {0..=0}
output         : 0


ast            : CAST(0 AS UINT8 NULL)
raw expr       : CAST(0 AS UInt8 NULL)
checked expr   : CAST<UInt8>(0_u8 AS UInt8 NULL)
optimized expr : 0_u8
output type    : UInt8 NULL
output domain  : {0..=0}
output         : 0

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Numbers and booleans

A number is true when it is not zero. A boolean converts to 1 or 0.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

raw expr       : CAST(0 AS Boolean)
checked expr   : CAST<UInt8>(0_u8 AS Boolean)
optimized expr : false
output type    : Boolean
output domain  : {FALSE}
output         : false

optimized expr : true
output type    : Boolean
